mapper.insert: insert into `orders` (id, user_id, account_id, symbol, order_type, order_status, quantity, price, total_amount, created_at, completed_at, fail_reason) values (#{id}, #{userId}, #{accountId}, #{symbol}, #{orderType}, #{orderStatus}, #{quantity}, #{price}, #{totalAmount}, #{createdAt}, #{completedAt}, #{failReason});
